case_number: 2024 INSC 189; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 1335 OF 2024; SLP (Crl.) No(s). 16426 of 2023
summary: Quashing proceedings under Section 482 CrPC based on settlement agreement; non-compoundable offences under IPC s.147,148,149,364; victim as non-party to settlement; HC’s quashing overturned; distinction between public/private wrongs; Gian Singh principles applied; SLP filed as original complainant’s remedy exhausted.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.147, s.148, s.149, s.323, s.364
Gian Singh v. State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303
Narinder Singh & Ors. Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. 2014 Law Suit (SC) 202
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court’s quashing order set aside; trial proceedings reinstated.
